title: OKF bundle configuration
description: Configuration for a single OKF knowledge bundle. Used either in okf.config.json or in bundle.config.json.

systemPath.description: A system path. It can be absolute, or relative to the config file. Accepts both Windows and POSIX path syntax.

name.description: Optional kebab-case name used to address this bundle, e.g. in CLI arguments or when asking the user to disambiguate between multiple configured bundles.

linkFormat.description: Default link format used in the bundle. Used during writing and linting.

logging.description: How changes are recorded: log.md -> maintain log.md; git -> rely on git history; none -> no change log.

maxBundleDepth.description: Maximum directory nesting depth allowed within a bundle, measured from bundleRoot (depth 0).

requiredProperties.description: Frontmatter properties every concept must carry. 'type' is always required by OKF and is ignored if listed here.
